items.title: Allen Toussaint Interview, 1979-03-13
items.q: I've seen some little youngsters that hasn't been around long enough to have been through too much, and they sing with so much like Michael Jackson.

ctx.x: You had to go through those feelings.

I do say theoretically because there's something about people that work hard at things that I can't overlook. And I've seen some little youngsters that hasn't been around long enough to have been through too much, and they sing with so much like Michael Jackson. I hear more feelings in him sometimes than an 80-year-old man.
